title: Learning Mixtures of Plackett-Luce Models for Multi-Objective Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.25200v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of learning a mixture of $k$ Plackett-Luce models given multi-way ranking responses from annotators that may represent heterogeneous underlying preferences. This problem has many applications in AI alignment and preference optimization. Prior work has studied mixtures of Bradley-Terry models from pairwise comparisons. However, uncovering mixture models is theoretically unidentifiable when $k$ exceeds $m/2$, where $m$ is the length of a ranking. We propose an efficient implementation to address this limitation, which involves first augmenting the rankings to a larger size by generating new responses from a base language model, followed by a gradient-based estimation to reduce inference cost in the input embedding space. translated_title: 学习多目标对齐的Plackett-Luce模型混合
translated_abstract: 我们考虑从可能代表异质底层偏好的标注者提供的多路排序响应中，学习k个Plackett-Luce模型的混合问题。该问题在AI对齐和偏好优化中有许多应用。先前的工作研究了基于成对比较的Bradley-Terry模型混合。然而，当k超过m/2（其中m是排序长度）时，揭示混合模型在理论上不可识别。我们提出了一种高效的实现来解决这一限制，该实现首先通过从基础语言模型生成新响应来将排序扩展至更大规模，然后采用基于梯度的估计来降低输入嵌入空间的推理成本。基于此过程，我们设计了一个包含这两个步骤的期望最大化算法来拟合Plackett-Luce模型混合，称为MoPLEx。进行了大量实验以验证其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出MoPLEx算法，通过扩展排序数据和梯度估计，解决了k超过m/2时Plackett-Luce模型混合不可识别的问题，实现了多目标对齐中的高效偏好学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the MoPLEx algorithm, which addresses the unidentifiability issue of Plackett-Luce mixture models when k exceeds m/2 by augmenting rankings and using gradient-based estimation, enabling efficient preference learning for multi-objective alignment.
